works.body:
Nice to meet you!
I saw your illustration on Twitter from the "New Creators" section and made a request.

I would like to ask you to create an illustration of Kogamino Ono, an individual V.
https://twitter.com/3Ewrs/status/1544678305093128192
I would like to request an illustration of a girl who looks hot like Iroha-chan who was drawn the other day.
She is wearing a shirt and shorts, and I would like to see her holding an ice cream in her mouth.
I would be happy if the background is a tatami room or a porch.
Hair style, facial expressions, etc. are up to the artist.

I would appreciate it if you could give me permission to use the illustration in my activities (SNS, thumbnails, etc.) and if you could also give me a layered version of the address, etc. when you deliver it.
Thank you in advance.

https://twitter.com/kogaminoono/status/1477289180401369089
https://twitter.com/kogaminoono
